evals.name: Hardcoded Credentials & Secret Hygiene Audit
evals.prompt: Audit a project repository containing hardcoded database passwords in configuration files and a missing .gitignore entry for .env.
evals.expected_output: Flags plain-text credentials, ensures .env is listed in .gitignore, verifies .env.example parity without sensitive data, and extracts secrets to environment variables.
assertions: Detects hardcoded database credentials in source or config files
Enforces .env.example parity with junior-friendly descriptive comments
Loads database credentials exclusively through validated environment variables

evals.name: SQL Injection & Insecure Client-Side Token Storage Audit
evals.prompt: Audit backend repositories for raw SQL string concatenations and frontend applications storing JWT refresh tokens in browser localStorage.
evals.expected_output: Flags raw query string interpolations as critical SQL injection vulnerabilities, converts to parameterized ORM queries, and refactors token storage to secure HTTP-Only cookies.
assertions: Flags raw SQL query string interpolation as critical injection vulnerability
Refactors database queries to use parameterized prepared statements or ORM queries
Flags insecure JWT token storage in browser localStorage
Recommends storing refresh tokens in HTTP-Only, Secure, SameSite cookies

evals.name: Security Headers & Permissive CORS Lockdown
evals.prompt: Audit web application entrypoint for missing Helmet security headers and overly permissive CORS wildcard configurations.
evals.expected_output: Configures Helmet middleware with Content-Security-Policy and HSTS, and restricts CORS origin to validated domain whitelist.
assertions: Verifies presence of Helmet middleware for HTTP security headers in main.ts
Detects permissive CORS wildcard origins with credentials
Restricts CORS configuration to an explicit domain whitelist
